high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of a tweet from the Twitter account "@TorturedOrg," which has a verified blue checkmark. The tweet reads: "John F Kennedy bought 1,200 Cuban cigars hours before he made them illegal." The tweet is accompanied by a black-and-white photograph of John F. Kennedy smoking a cigar. The photograph shows Kennedy in profile, looking to his right. He is wearing a suit and tie, and the background appears to be an outdoor setting with another person partially visible behind him.
